taxes.tax: Per-worker fees on employers (work permits of foreign workers)
unsupported: 3000 taxes on payroll and workforce: work-permit fees for foreign workers (Labour Law 37/2015 and its instructions; not read); no payroll tax in the laws read (ITL 113/1982, Retirement and Social Security Law 18/2023). Coordinator decision of pass 3l: OECD 3000 covers taxes paid by employers as a fixed amount per person employed, so a per-worker fee levied by law on employers belongs here and the heading is not cited absent until the fee text is read; a one-off permit issuance charge that does not scale with the workforce is not a tax (note only). No company input carries the workforce by nationality. Grade C (pass 3l).

notLevied.why: 5111: no value added tax: Constitution of the Republic of Iraq (2005) art. 28 First: no taxes or fees are levied, amended, collected or exempted except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Iraq_2005.txt); the only sales tax law is RCC decision 36/1997 (10 % on hotel and restaurant services, extended to the second class by Budget Law 13/2023 art. 20), a tax on specific services modelled under 5120; convention R5-3k-G (constitutional reservation of taxes to law + no law in force) (pass 3k).

4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of the Republic of Iraq (2005) art. 28 First: no taxes or fees shall be levied, amended, collected or exempted except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Iraq_2005.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Law 113/1982, RCC decision 36/1997 (sales tax), Federal Budget Law 13/2023, Retirement and Social Security Law 18/2023. convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).

4300: no inheritance, estate or gift tax: Constitution of the Republic of Iraq (2005) art. 28 First: no taxes or fees shall be levied, amended, collected or exempted except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Iraq_2005.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Law 113/1982, RCC decision 36/1997 (sales tax), Federal Budget Law 13/2023, Retirement and Social Security Law 18/2023. convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).
